comment: Machine-readable fleet denominator: every supervised module, its source repo, and how its binary is acquired. Consumers: E2E's cross-module gate derives its checkout list from this file (per-module exclusions carry reasons here, never in a hand-list); fleet-pulse diffs the DEPLOYED subc.jsonc roster against this file both directions, so deployed-vs-committed drift alarms at the seat that owns deployed state. Update rule: any change to the supervised module set lands here in the same change; the fleet-pulse two-arm diff is the tripwire for forgetting. Build-only dependency repos (no supervised module, but path-dep targets of siblings) carry rows in build_dependencies with reasons -- a checkout derivation is manifest source repos UNION build_dependencies; deriving from modules alone drops the repo whose bumps start lock waves. lock_refresh: 'auto' means the subconscious post-bump runner executes the lock-only refresh recipe in that repo (owner opted in, owner's gate remains acceptance authority); 'manual' means the owner absorbs waves themselves. E2E's convergence gate splits stale counts by this field so a partial rollout cannot misread untreated repos as mechanism failure.

aft.gate_exclusion_reason: acquired as reviewed release asset by design; not built from source by consumers

condition-runner.comment: compiled bun binary staged from the wakes lane; source of truth is the vendored runner in subconscious

commons.reason: not a supervised module; path-dep target of every Rust sibling (cortexkit-store-types, cortexkit-paths, cortexkit-lease); version bumps here invalidate sibling committed locks, so any cross-module gate must build against it
